verdict.rationale: Groq is an inference API platform, so event webhooks are a fair axis; it could, for example, notify on batch completion. Nothing in the evidence documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. The async Batch API, budget alerts and the changelog's RSS/email subscription are adjacent features, not webhooks a programmatic consumer can register and receive.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
